late: Assignment Policy. Assignments course outline mein di gayi date ko raat 11:59 PM tak submit karni hoti hain. Late submission par har din ke hisaab se normally ten percent marks cut hote hain. Agar student bemar ho to extension ke liye deadline se pehle medical proof dena zaroori hai. Student ko medical certificate course coordinator ko bhejna hota hai aur written reply ka wait karna hota hai. Travel plans ya doosre courses ke workload ki wajah se extension nahi milti. Group projects mein bhi yehi rule follow hota hai. Har member ko apni illness ki information coordinator ko alag deni hoti hai. Late work submit hone par coordinator submission time check karta hai aur approved extension ke mutabiq penalty calculate karta hai. Student ko final marks ke saath penalty ki explanation bhi di jati hai. Student five working days ke andar penalty review ki request kar sakta hai. Tamam assignments check hone ke baad marks learning portal par upload kar diye jate hain.
password: IT Help Guide. Har student ko university ka ek account milta hai jo email, learning portal aur library ke liye use hota hai. Agar password bhool jayein to recovery link se password reset kar sakte hain. Ye link login page par hota hai aur registered phone number ya alternate email par bheja jata hai. Apne recovery codes kisi ke saath share na karein. Agar five wrong attempts ke baad account lock ho jaye to help desk se unlock karwana hota hai. Help desk student card aur problem ki short details mangta hai, lekin current password nahi mangta. Password reset hone ke baad shared computers se logout karein aur kam az kam twelve characters ka new password rakhein. University aur personal accounts ke liye same password use na karein. Passwords har one hundred and eighty days baad expire hote hain aur expiry se fourteen days pehle reminder milta hai.
assignment: Submission Guide. Har course mein written assignments submit karne ka same method hota hai taake files lost na hon. Assignments learning portal ke through upload karein. Final file PDF format mein honi chahiye aur file name mein course code aur student number likhna zaroori hai. Agar student portal access nahi kar sakta to deadline se pehle file coordinator ko email kar sakta hai aur sent email ka proof save rakhna chahiye. Portal twenty megabytes tak ki files accept karta hai. Bari files ko compress ya do parts mein divide karna chahiye. Har upload ke baad receipt milti hai jisme date aur time hota hai. Is receipt ko final marks aane tak save rakhein. Deadline se pehle latest uploaded file check hoti hai. Student zaroorat ke mutabiq file dobara upload kar sakta hai. Source code, data files aur images ko ek folder mein rakh kar report ke saath single archive mein submit karna hota hai. Har upload ka plagiarism check automatically hota hai.
contractor: Remote Work Policy. Ye policy batati hai ke staff aur contractors kahan se kaam kar sakte hain aur unki requests kaise approve hoti hain. Employees apne manager ki permission se har week three days ghar se kaam kar sakte hain. Contractors sirf tab remote work kar sakte hain jab unke signed contract mein iski permission ho. Employee rules contractors par apply nahi hote. Is liye manager sirf zubani permission de kar contractor ko remote work allow nahi kar sakta. Agar contract mein remote work ka zikr nahi hai to contractor ko office se kaam karna hoga jab tak human resources office contract mein written change na kar de. Policy ka version one ab cancel ho chuka hai. Is purani policy mein contractors ko bina contract permission ke two days remote work ki ijazat thi. Purani policy ki copy ab use nahi karni chahiye. Contract change ki request human resources office ko contract number ke saath bheji jati hai. Office ten working days mein reply deta hai. Remote workers ko office hours mein available rehna hota hai, approved company laptops use karne hote hain aur secure network ke through connect rehna zaroori hai.
printer: Printer Troubleshooting Guide. Ye guide office ke har floor par available shared printers aur unke common problems ke bare mein hai. Agar printer blank pages de raha ho to ink level check karein aur cleaning utility run karein. Iske baad test page print karein taake confirm ho sake ke problem solve hui hai ya nahi. Result maintenance log mein bhi likhein. Agar test page phir bhi blank ho to cartridge nikalein, protective tape check karein aur cartridge ko dobara properly lagayein. Agar scanner image blank aa rahi ho to ye alag problem hai. Is case mein document ki placement check karein aur correct scanning source select karein. Storage room ke purane laser printers mein drum unit use hota hai. Un models mein blank pages aane par drum replace karna hota hai, lekin ye rule current inkjet printers par apply nahi hota. Printing ke waqt printer ko kabhi open na karein. Paper jam hone par sheet nikalne se pehle printer ko off karein. Agar problem bar bar aaye to printer label aur failure time ke saath help desk ko report karein.
